descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上面的一些植物在自然选择中进化出了一套有效的自我防御措施。许多的树木和真菌都会释放出孢子，这些孢子对非植物生命来说具有非常强的酸性。还好，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了中和其中一些孢子的方法，让这颗星球上的森林不那么致命了！
descriptions.en: It appears that some of [From.GetName]'s flora has developed effective defense mechanisms through natural selection. Numerous trees and fungi exude spores that act like a powerful acidic on non-plant organisms. Thankfully Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has found a way to counteract some strands of these spores, making the planet's forests less threatening to us!

tooltips.zh: £blocker£ 剧毒沼泽§R+2§!
tooltips.en: £blocker£ Noxious Swamp §R+2§!

descriptions.zh:
看来，小行星[From.GetName]及其周围碎片来源于一个已经消亡的星球！

在小行星中心，我们可以找到极具价值的合金的痕迹。同时，这里还找到了一些已死于在真空中的细菌曾经的活动迹象。这一切表明了这个天体曾孕育过生命。
descriptions.en:
It appears that the asteroid [From.GetName] and the surrounding debris originate from a former planet!

Deep within the center of the asteroid we can find traces of extremely valuable alloys. There are also hints of bacterial life that has now died in the vacuum of space. This shows us that the celestial body once bore the promise of life.

descriptions.zh: 我们接收到的信号来自于一艘围绕[From.GetName]旋转的舰船。这艘船现在没有任何热成像，似乎是在漂浮。我们已经制定了一个§S特殊项目§!来调查船员的遭遇。
descriptions.en: The signal we intercepted was a distress call from a ship in orbit around [From.GetName]. The ship is not giving off any heat signatures and seems to be drifting. A §SSpecial Project§! has been issued to investigate what has happened to the crew.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

options.script: name = NOTIME

descriptions.zh: 舰上的船员已经全部丧生。更令人不安的是，他们似乎是被某种高度发达的脑寄生虫杀死的。它们寄生在船员的脑子里并使其疯狂。多亏了科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]及时发现，我们的船员才没有被感染。
descriptions.en: The crew of the ship has been found dead. What is more disturbing is that they appear to have been killed by some highly advanced brain parasites, which infested them and drove them mad. Thanks to Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s findings we were able to protect our own crew from being infected!

descriptions.zh: 围绕[From.From.From.GetName]运行的舰船并没有被遗弃。上面的船员还活着，但是状态不好。他们受到了某种脑寄生虫的影响。我们的科学家能够轻松地治愈他们。
descriptions.en: The ship in orbit around [From.From.From.GetName] was not abandoned. The crew is alive, but not well, influenced by some sort of brain parasite. With the help of our scientists they could easily be cured.

tooltips.zh: 与外星人建立联系。
tooltips.en: Establish contact with the aliens.

descriptions.zh: 尽管宛如大海捞针，[Root.GetName]精确地找出了那个穿过了小行星带的奇怪信号的来源。信号来源于一个小型外星物品。简单的扫描显示出它是一种仪式性的容器，里面装着某位外星宇航员的遗体。
descriptions.en: By what has to be beyond astronomical odds, the [Root.GetName] actually managed to pinpoint the source of the odd signals as it soared past through the asteroid belt. A tiny, alien construct. A simple scan reveals that it is some sort of a ritualistic container, holding the remains of an alien spacefarer.

label.zh: 让那个棺材继续它的旅途吧。
label.en: Let the coffin continue its voyage.

label.zh: 打开棺材，研究那具尸体。
label.en: Open the coffin and study the corpse.

label.zh: 把它带回[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]，放在博物馆里面展出。
label.en: Bring it to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and display it in a museum.

label.zh: 有很多值得学习的东西。打开荚舱。
label.en: There is much to learn. Open the pod.

descriptions.zh:
距离我们和[DefiledCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]第一次接触已经过去几天了，现在他们向我们发来了一则消息：

“我们知道你们做了什么，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们开启的那个棺材是我们第一位星际宇航员最后的休憩之处。我们要求你们道歉！”
descriptions.en:
A couple of days have passed since we first made contact with the [DefiledCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and now they are sending us a message:

"We know what you have done, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The casket you desecrated was the final resting place of our first star traveler. We demand an apology!"

tooltips.zh: 你们之间的关系会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Your relationship will be affected.

label.zh: 我们会为你们祖先的灵魂祈祷。
label.en: We will pray for the spirit of your ancestor.

tooltips.zh: 你们之间的关系会受到影响。
tooltips.en: Your relationship will be affected.

label.en: It is merely a dead body.

label.zh: 异星杂种，我们根本就不在乎！
label.en: We could not care less, alien scum!

tooltips.en: Your relationship will be affected.

descriptions.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了那些奇怪的矿物读数的源头。[From.GetName]是巨型宇宙舰船的坟场，这里的舰船残骸已经沉睡了几百万年。[Root.GetLeaderName]还说道，“真是太遗憾了，这些推进器损坏过于严重，仔细检测也不会有什么结果。”
descriptions.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has found the source of the odd mineral readings. [From.GetName] is a graveyard for gargantuan spaceships that have been resting there for millions of years. [Root.GetLeaderName] goes on and on in the debriefing about a "profound sadness that the rockets are too broken down for even careful examination to yield results."

descriptions.zh: 我们发现那些奇怪的矿物读数来源于一些数量不明，异常巨大且技术先进的太空船残骸。飞船部件的锈蚀情况表明这片残骸于大约2,380,669年前产生。现场的科研单位试图对这些舰船的推进器进行逆向工程，但因其破损过于严重而失败了。
descriptions.en: We have discovered that the source of the odd mineral readings are the remains of an unconfirmed number of abnormally large, technologically advanced spaceships. Material decomposition indicates an age of approximately 2 380 669 years. The science unit on site attempted to reverse engineer the vessels' rockets but failed due to their heavily damaged state.

descriptions.zh: 通过彻底的扫描，我们发现了[From.GetName]奇异矿石成分的成因。[From.GetPlanetMoon]是几十艘巨型太空船的坠毁地点，其船体之大远远超出我们的想象。它们建造的时间可以追溯到几百万年前。
descriptions.en: Thorough scans have revealed the cause of [From.GetName]'s odd metal composition. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is the crash site of dozens of massive spaceships, larger than anything we could have ever imagined. Their construction dates back several million years.

label.zh: 至少这些材料还很有用。
label.en: At least the materials will be useful.

label.zh: 这些材料会派上用场的。
label.en: The materials will surely come in handy.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]的沙丘下面，我们的科学团队找到了坠毁的战斗机舰队。虽然很古老，但是却保存的十分完好。它们早已经被遗弃，但是引擎和照明部件似乎还能运作。它们坠毁的原因目前尚不清楚。我们在旗舰的舰桥上面找到了舰队的人工智能，它能够在战斗中指挥这些船只，并且其仍在运作。我们靠近的时候，它拉响了警报。在入侵者靠近的时候它就会自动启动。
我们能够施行一个§S特殊项目§!在这个人工智能发疯之前回收它。我们也可以毁了它，避免未知的风险。
descriptions.en:
Under the dunes of [From.GetName] the science team has found a fleet of crashed fighters. Ancient, yet well preserved. They are abandoned, but the lights and engines seem to function. Why they crashed is a mystery. On the main ship bridge we found a fleet AI, capable of controlling the ships in battle. It is still active. As we approach a warning signal calls. It is programmed to activate when threatened by intruders!
A §SSpecial Project§! can be issued to try and salvage the AI before it goes haywire, or we could destroy it and avoid the risk.

label.zh: 试着去控制这个人工智能。
label.en: Try and take control of the AI.

label.zh: 在它试图做危险的事情之前毁了它。
label.en: Destroy it before it tries anything.

tooltips.zh:
毁掉这个人工智能。

向[From.GetName]添加§Y坠毁的人工智能舰队§!修正：
£engineering£§G+2§!
tooltips.en:
Destroys the AI.

Adds the §YCrashed AI-Fleet§! modifier to [From.GetName]:
£engineering£ §G+2§!

descriptions.zh: 谢天谢地，我们成功地在人工智能攻击我们之前为它重新编写了程序。它目前已可作为我们舰队中的旗舰工作，并且如果我们愿意的话，它也可以成为指挥官。这个人工智能已经被运送到我们的母星，等待指派。
descriptions.en: Thankfully we were able to reprogram the AI before it turned on us. It has been repurposed to commandeer ships in our fleet, and could act as a sort of Commander if we so choose. The AI has been transported to our homeworld, awaiting assignment.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了有趣的东西，不过跟[From.GetPlanetMoon]本身没有什么关系。我们像往常一样进行测试时，突然捕获到一颗遥远的恒星系中的恒星传出的奇怪数据。该恒星的辐射表明，它可以在不发生散裂的情况下让铍原子发生聚变，而这根本就是不可能的！

科学团队已经迫不及待想前去一探究竟了，而且他们已经将范围缩小到两个不是很远的恒星系。
查询§S情报日志§!获取细节。
descriptions.en:
We have made an interesting find on [From.GetName], however it is not related to the [From.GetPlanetMoon] itself. While conducting our usual tests we captured some odd data from a far-off system's star. Its radiation indicates that it is able to fuse together beryllium without spallation; something that should not be possible!

The science team are eager to investigate and have limited the potential stars down to two not-too-distant systems.
Consult the §SSituation Log§! for details.

label.zh: 这可能会带来丰厚的收获。

label.en: We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh: 我们找到了正确的恒星系！这颗恒星的辐射数据和之前遇到的完全一致。我们制定了一个§S特殊项目§!来对这颗恒星进行研究。
descriptions.en: We seem to have found the right system! The radiation data of the local star match the ones previously encountered. A §SSpecial Project§! has been issued to perform research on the star.

descriptions.zh:
明白了！科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现这个恒星是围绕一个小型虫洞形成的。虫洞撕开了一道维度裂缝，从其他维度来的射线代替了宇宙射线，使得元素的散裂无法发生。超新星辐射导致这颗恒星中形成的铍-8衰变成了更稳定的元素，因此这颗恒星内发生的核聚变十分特别。

这些知识并不会使我们现有的科技得到提升。但是，它告诉了我们更多关于宇宙运行原理的信息。
descriptions.en:
Eureka! Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has found that the star is formed around a miniscule wormhole, which has ripped open a dimensional rift. Rays from this other dimension has replaced the need of cosmic rays in spallation, the process of supernovae radiation reducing the beryllium-8 created in stars into a stable element. The star is thus unique in its fusion capabilities.

This knowledge won't expand our available technology. However, it grants us more insight into what makes the universe tick.

descriptions.zh:
明白了！科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现这个恒星是围绕一个小型虫洞形成的。虫洞撕开了一道维度裂缝，从其他维度来的射线代替了宇宙射线，使得元素的散裂无法发生。超新星辐射导致这颗恒星中形成的铍-8衰变成了更稳定的元素，因此这颗恒星内发生的核聚变十分特别。

多亏了这个发现，我们的科学家现在能够研究新的科技了！
descriptions.en:
Eureka! Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has found that the star is formed around a miniscule wormhole, which has ripped open a dimensional rift. Rays from this other dimension has replaced the need of cosmic rays in spallation, the process of supernovae radiation reducing the beryllium-8 created in stars into a stable element. The star is thus unique in its fusion capabilities.

Thanks to this discovery our scientists will be able to research new technology!

label.zh: 我们已经掌握了恒星的奥秘。
label.en: We have mastered the secrets of suns.

label.zh: 我们正在逐步揭开宇宙神秘的面纱。
label.en: The mysteries of the universe are slowly revealed.

label.en: The mysteries of the universe are slowly revealed.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的离子辐射强度已经爆表了。看起来[From.GetPlanetMoon]似乎最近受到了核弹头的轰炸，或者是暴露在了可能是从附近超新星所发出的聚集射线束之中。至于后者是否能够造成这种效果，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]毫无头绪。
descriptions.en: The ionizing radiation on [From.GetName] is off the charts. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] seems to either have been bombarded with nuclear warheads quite recently or been exposed to a concentrated beam of cosmic rays, perhaps from a nearby supernova. How the latter could ever be achieved is beyond Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName].

descriptions.zh:
经过缜密研究之后，[Root.GetName]的成员探测到了一个“微弱”的回声正在从[From.GetName]的地底深处传来。

这种回声有点像是生命体发出的。可是我们与它的距离实在是太远了，很难分辨它是真的，还是只是一台发出随机信号的设备。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的手下一直在抱怨说自己得不到适当的休息，工作时间又太长，自己再也受不了了。
descriptions.en:
After rigorous research, the crew of [Root.GetName] has only been able to detect a faint "echo" emanating deep beneath the surface of [From.GetName].

The echo resembles a life signature, however it is so distant it is hard to tell if it is real or just the instruments giving off random variations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s crew is complaining about bad rest and long hours and cannot take much more.

label.zh: 校正探测仪，再好好看看星球的内核！
label.en: Calibrate the scanners and look closer to the core!

label.zh: “我们不能相信这些船员。我们需要一次实地考察！”
label.en: "The crew cannot be trusted. An expedition is needed!"

label.zh: 船员的健康是第一位的。
在弄清楚之前，我们绝不能停下！
label.en: We cannot rest until we get to the bottom of this!

descriptions.zh:
尽管大家都筋疲力尽了，但是在调整了舰船的探测仪后，[Root.GetName]的船员和科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]得到了一个惊人的发现。在[From.From.GetName]的内核附近，有一种类似于浮游生物的生命体。它们分布于整个[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]，有着共同的意识，以及强大的灵能能力。

这种生命体能够在极高的压力和温度下存活，甚至可以以极高的速率进行繁衍。它看起来像是在冬眠……或者是在躲避什么东西，就好像它知道自己正在被观测一样。

对于如此巨大而拥有诸多优势的生命体，理论上来说它是永生的。不过，它看起来并不会妨碍我们对[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]进行殖民。但是它可能会对上面的居民产生一些负面影响。
descriptions.en:
After doing some adjustments to the ship scanners, the crew of [Root.GetName] and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], although exhausted and on edge, have made a startling discovery. Close to the core of [From.From.GetName] is a plankton-like lifeform that stretches across the entire [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], living in a shared consciousness with vast psionic abilities.

The lifeform is able to survive under both extreme pressures and temperatures. It can even expand itself at rapid rates. It seem to either be hibernating or... hiding, as if it knew it was being watched.

A lifeform this vast in size and versatile seems technically immortal. However it does not seem like it would hinder us to colonize the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], but it might have a negative influence on the population.

label.zh: 我们应该试着去和它接触。
label.en: We should try and contact it.

label.zh: 我们可以向海中下毒并杀死它。
label.en: We could poison the ocean to kill it.

tooltips.zh:
§Y你的帝国§!获得了§R负面媒体报道§!修正效果。

添加§R敌对环境§!修正效果至[From.From.GetName]。
tooltips.en:
§YYour Empire§! gains the §RNegative Media Coverage§! modifier.

Adds the §RHostile Environment§! modifier to [From.From.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
在多次尝试接触而没有结果后，我们的小队决定尝试用声波进行联系。声波使那个生物产生了巨大的反应，所有的小队成员都双膝跪地，陷入了栩栩如生的幻象之中。

这好像是这种生物的主要交流方式。它描述了它的母星，它静静地躺在星核附近，沐浴在[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的温暖之中，在黑暗中繁衍。然后它向我们展示了我们的人民站在地表上，在阳光中繁衍壮大。
descriptions.en:
After trying several methods of contact without an answer the team decides to try sonar pings. The sound waves cause a massive reaction in the being and every crew member falls to their knees, struck with vivid visions.

This seems to be the creatures' main form of communication. It depicts its homeworld, where it lies alone near the core basking in the warmth of the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon], thriving in the darkness. Then it shows our people, standing on the surface, thriving in the sunshine.

label.zh: 我们很乐意接受这份邀请。

tooltips.zh: §Y你的帝国§!获得了§R负面媒体报道§!修正效果。
tooltips.en: §YYour Empire§! gains the §RNegative Media Coverage§! modifier.

descriptions.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快就合成出了一种毒药，它应该会和这个生物的内在结构产生剧烈的反应，以野火之势扩散开来。

在释放了毒药之后，船员们陷入到了极大的恐惧之中。他们目睹了一个史无前例的事件。[From.From.From.GetName]的内核温度急剧升高，导致整个海洋沸腾。生命体那巨大的躯体也开始向大气中释放毒素。这个浮游生物般的东西对于[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]那不稳定的核心来说一定是至关重要的。这种毒素应该也是它在进化中得到的一种自我防御的机制。

[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]在几个小时之内就充满了剧毒。
descriptions.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] quickly synthesizes a poison that should react well with the creature's interconnected form and spread like wildfire.

After releasing the poison the crew stare in horror as they bear witness to an unprecedented event. [From.From.From.GetName]'s core temperature spirals out of control which causes the oceans to boil. The creature's gargantuan body also releases toxins into the atmosphere. The plankton entity must have been vital in the regulation of the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s unstable center, as well as developed toxic defense mechanisms in order to protect itself.

The [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon] becomes completely toxic in a matter of hours.

descriptions.zh:
由于怀疑这些船员想要隐瞒什么，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]决定发起一场不经批准的单枪匹马的探险，以仔细检查星球的内核。船上潜艇的摄像机传回了录像带，记录了事情的经过：

深入[From.From.GetName]的海洋，那里只有黑暗。但是，还有一些……活着的东西。在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]温暖的内核附近有一些深海洞穴。洞穴的里面有网状的、类似于浮游生物的植被，缠绕着[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的整个地壳。

在调查浮游生物的时候，[Root.GetLeaderName]突然癫痫发作，在几个小时之后才醒过来。

回到[Root.GetName]后，科学专员神志不清，一直在诉说一些关于恐惧和邪恶幻境的事情。
descriptions.en:
Suspicious that the crew is hiding something, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] decided to mount an unauthorized solo-expedition to examine the planet's core. A video feed from the ships submarine shows what happened:

Going deep into the oceans of [From.From.GetName] there is only darkness, but also something... alive. Inside deep-sea caverns close to the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s warm core there are webs of plankton-like vegetation, that spans the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s entire crust.

While investigating the plankton [Root.GetLeaderName] is stricken with a seizure, only to awake hours later.

After returning to the [Root.GetName] the Science Officer is delusional and only speaks of horrors and haunted visions.

label.zh: 科学专员也许只是太累了。
label.en: The Science Officer probably just needs rest.

tooltips.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] gains the §RManiacal§! Trait.

label.zh: 科学专员发疯了。把他抓起来！
label.en: The Science Officer is insane. To the brig!

tooltips.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]被永久停职了。
tooltips.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is permanently suspended.

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]的那次事件过去一个星期后，[Root.GetName]的船员被一声惊尖叫惊扰。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]大喊大叫，在船上横冲直撞，说自己感到很痛很痛。

船员们把他带到医务室给他打了大量镇定剂并仔细检查后确认[Root.GetLeaderName]的大脑发生了改变。

详细的检查最终发现这位领袖现在拥有了心灵感应能力，能够通过精神跟他人沟通。[Root.GetLeaderName]经过休息后会康复的。
descriptions.en:
It has been a week since the incident on [From.From.From.GetName] when the crew of the [Root.GetName] are disturbed by a loud scream. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is yelling, running through the halls of the ship, going on about inexplicable pains.

The crew brings the poor scientist to the sickbay and after heavy sedation and a thorough examination concludes that [Root.GetLeaderName]'s brain has changed.

After further tests the team startlingly realizes that their leader is now capable of telekinesis and communicating with others via telepathy. [Root.GetLeaderName] is going to get healthy, after some rest.

descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName]'s crew ends their research of [From.From.GetName], thankful of finally getting some rest. Sadly there were not any useful finds, but news of the crew being well-treated spreads fast and brings forth many a good word on our homeworld. descriptions.zh:
夜以继日地研究回声的根源后，[Root.GetName]发现了[From.From.GetName]地面下生活的一种生物。之前没有发觉是因为它生活在非常靠近[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]核心的地方，这导致我们的系统分析对它毫无效用。

通过扫描我们发现它是尚处于进化早期阶段的海洋节肢动物，但最神奇的是它竟然能够将死去的生物物质改造成自己的后代。

这个信息非常有助于我们的科学家开发新的药物！不过，我们对待我们的人员的方式肯定会传播出去，造成不良影响。
descriptions.en:
After working day and night in order to find the reason behind the echo, the crew of [Root.GetName] have found an interesting lifeform living underneath the surface of [From.From.GetName]. Previously we could not detect it due to its amazing ability to live so close to the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s core, throwing off our systems analytics.

Scans show it to be a type of aquatic arthropod early in its evolution, but what is most surprising is the fact that it is able to reproduce by repurposing dead matter from other lifeforms into offspring.

This information will surely help our scientists to develop new pharmaceuticals! However, news of how we treated our personnel will surely spread and displease the general populace.

tooltips.zh: §Y你的帝国§!获得了§G药物创新§!和§R负面媒体报道§!修正。
tooltips.en: §YYour Empire§! gains the §GPharmaceutical Innovation§! and §RNegative Media Coverage§! modifiers.

descriptions.zh: 对[From.GetName]的研究结束后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报说他们发现这颗行星满是矿物。这个发现主要归功于[Root.GetName]的船员。[Root.GetLeaderName]对这位学徒赞赏有加。
descriptions.en: After the study of [From.GetName] has concluded, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that they have found the planet to be unusually rich in minerals. This discovery was made possible in large part thanks to a certain member of the [Root.GetName] crew. [Root.GetLeaderName] praises the protégé highly.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告。据说有一个……陶瓷容器在围绕着[From.GetName]的恒星旋转。真奇怪。

这种东西不应该出现那儿，然而不管怎样它确实在近地轨道上。

可以发布§S特殊项目§!来研究该容器并找出它出现在那里的原因。
descriptions.en:
We have gotten a report from Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]. It seems that a... ceramic container is circling the star [From.GetName]. Most peculiar.

It should obviously not be there, yet somehow it has managed to find its way into a close orbit.

A §SSpecial Project§! can be issued to investigate the container and try to deduce how it ended up there.

label.zh: 不是所有问题都得有答案。
label.en: All questions don't have worthwhile answers.
Surely this is a sign of the divine.

descriptions.zh:
我们竭尽所能试图找出这个陶瓷容器出现在恒星轨道的原因。也许这是我们的集体幻觉？也许它根本不存在？连这些可能性我们都计算过了。但是一无所获。我们尽力了。

唯一的好处就是当我们再也无法忍受调查这东西时，我们可以慢慢研究哲学和经济问题。
descriptions.en:
We have tried everything in order to find out how the ceramic pot ended up in a stellar orbit. Maybe we are all crazy? Maybe it does not even exist? Guess what? We tried calculating around those facts as well! We are done. There is nothing more we can do here.

The only plus side to this is that we had tons of time to spend on philosophical and economical questions, when we could not stomach to keep investigating that damned thing.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = no } }

descriptions.zh:
我们竭尽所能试图找出这个陶瓷容器出现在大空轨道的原因。或许我们都故障了？或许它根本就不存在？<<错误！>>连这些可能性我们都计算过了。<<错误！>>
这事儿到此为止。我们尽力了。

这项调查的一个好处就是，当我们无法容忍继续调查那个不合逻辑的罐子时，我们可以花大量的时间在理论与经济问题上。
descriptions.en:
We have tried everything in order to find out how the ceramic container ended up in a stellar orbit. Perhaps we are all malfunctioning? Perhaps it does not even exist? <<Error!>> We attempted to calculate around those facts as well. <<Error!>>
We are done. There is nothing more we can do here.

The one positive aspect of this investigation is that we had excessive amounts of time to spend on theoretical and economical questions, when we could not bear to keep investigating that illogical pot.

tooltips.zh: 接受解决生活问题的尝试常常徒劳无功的事实。
tooltips.en: Embrace the futility of life's questions.

tooltips.zh: 接受存在的无意义性。
tooltips.en: Embrace the futility of existence.

descriptions.zh:
在几乎要放弃继续研究这可恶的陶瓷物体时，我们终于取得了突破！该容器是一个神圣遗物，无疑是由神灵留在轨道上的信号！

该物体散发着能量，解码后终于显示出隐藏的信息：那是能够改善我们的研究能力以助我们尽早升天的信息！

现在唯一的问题是……究竟是谁发来的这道信息？
descriptions.en:
After almost giving up hope, studying the accursed ceramic object for so long, we have reached a breakthrough! The container is a sacred relic, left in orbit as a sign, surely from the divine!

The object is brimming with energy, which when decrypted reveals its hidden message: information on how to help us ascend by improving our research efforts!

The only question now is... who sent this message?

descriptions.zh:
在花了大量时间研究那个陶瓷物体却并未取得明显进展之后，我们的科学单元终于有了突破。该物体并不存在于我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所知的三维空间中，而是一个来自更高维度的投影。

分析这个四维物体的本影让我们积累了足够的数据来解密它的信息。该物体教会我们如何在所有科研领域取得进展。

现在只剩下一个问题：是谁，或者是什么东西发送了这个信息？
descriptions.en:
After an extensive period of studying the confounding ceramic object without notable results, our scientific units have finally reached a breakthrough. The object does not exist in what we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know as three-dimensional spacetime, but rather it is a projection from a higher dimension.

Analyzing it, as an umbra of a fourth dimensional object, we have accumulated enough data to decrypt its message. The object teaches us how to attain improvements in all fields of research.

Only one question remains: Who or what sent this information?

在几乎要放弃继续研究这可恶的陶瓷物体时，我们终于取得了突破！该物体并非真是存在于那里，而是从更高级的维度投影下来的。分析发现，那是一个四维物体的影子，我们累积了足够的数据去解码它的信息。该物体能够改善我们对所有研究领域的认知。

descriptions.zh:
在巨型小行星[From.GetName]的地表下，我们发现了让人叹为观止的东西。有一台采矿设备安置在岩体上，一直挖到小行星地核深处！看情况它是被遗弃了，没有任何痕迹显示是谁留下的。

如果我们能够把这部机器停下，我们也许能够从中学习到制造它的科技，但一定要趁早，免得它被岩屑什么的压碎。
descriptions.en:
Deep within a crevice of the giant asteroid [From.GetName] we have found something astonishing. There is mining gear attached to the rock, digging itself into the vast depth of the asteroid! It stands abandoned, with no sign of who placed it there.

If we can stop the machine we might be able to learn something about the technology used to build it, but we must hurry before random debris crushes it.

descriptions.zh: 我们成功在挖掘机损坏之前制止了它。可惜它其实跟我们当前的设计非常类似，没有什么值得学习的。不过它挖出的洞可以让我们更轻易地找到贵重矿物。
descriptions.en: We managed to stop the excavator before it broke down. Sadly it is close to our own designs, and we can't really learn anything new from it. Thankfully the depths it carved out into the rock will make it easier to find valuable minerals.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功在挖掘机损坏之前制止了它。真是个神奇的机器，它的平滑的表层完全被钻石所覆盖。乍看之下，它似乎是一个整体，但其实只是做工精良，让人难以发现其连接处。

我们的工程师可以对它的一些科技进行逆向工程。
descriptions.en:
We managed to stop the excavator before it broke down. It's a remarkable piece of machinery, with a smooth surface covered in diamonds. At first glance the whole drill seems like one solid piece, but it's simply so well put together that you cannot notice the grooves and joints.

Our engineers will be able to reverse engineer some of this technology.

descriptions.zh: 好消息！我们发现[From.GetName]的热带雨林中生长着一种特殊的树，它的果实非常有营养。这种食物含有着惊人的能量以及我们的人民所需的全部营养。这确定无疑地有助于减轻我们殖民这个地方的压力。
descriptions.en: Good news! We have found the tropical forests of [From.GetName] to be host to a special kind of tree, blooming with nutritious fruits. The food produced stores tons of energy and contains all the chemicals our people need to function well. This will most assuredly make life a little bit easier to sustain, would we want to colonize.

descriptions.zh:
勘测过[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]的冰冻地面后，我们获得了重大发现。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说，发现了一种独一无二的细菌生物。它会跟其他个体连接起来组成巨大的“毯子”，这种毯子既轻便耐用，又能用作太阳能电池。它们能够非常高效地转化吸收到的太阳能——似乎是为了在这种环境下尽可能吸收多的热能而进化出来的。

我们的研究人员一定能够从这样的情报中发掘到可用之物。
descriptions.en:
Having probed the frozen landscapes of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] we think we have struck something big. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speaks of a bacterial lifeform unlike any other. It bonds with other individuals to form large "blankets" that are durable yet light, and also act like solar cells. They absorb solar energy with surprising efficiency - most likely a result of evolution favoring those who could gather more heat in the harsh climate.

Our researchers back home could surely find some use for this information.

label.zh: 分析它是否能够改善能量生产。
label.en: Find out if it can improve energy production.

tooltips.zh: 送回去母星作研究。需要一段时间才能出结果。
tooltips.en: Send to our homeworld for study. Results will take a while to process.

label.en: Try and find a military use.

tooltips.zh: 送回去母星作研究。需要一段时间才能出结果。
tooltips.en: Send to our homeworld for study. Results will take a while to process.

descriptions.zh: 我们的能源开发研究员从我们发过去的[From.From.GetName]样本中取得了进展！他们利用该生物为模板，成功开发了一种新的太阳能电池。这种电池能够更高效地储存能量并提高我们所有发电站的效率。
descriptions.en: Our energy development researchers have made progress with the samples we sent them from [From.From.GetName]! They have been able to develop a new type of solar cell using the organisms as a template. These are much more efficient at storing energy and will provide a boost to all our power plants.

descriptions.zh: 我们的军事开发研究员从我们发过去的[From.From.GetName]样本中取得了进展！他们改造了生物太阳能电池并分析了它们是如何储存热能而让自身不受伤害。这将有助于开发一种全新的舰队防御技术。
descriptions.en: Our military development researchers have made progress with the samples we sent them from [From.From.GetName]! They have reconstructed the biological solar cells and documented how they retain heat energy within themselves without taking damage. This has helped them develop a new defensive technology for our fleets.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一座传感阵列，孤零零的俯瞰着[From.GetName]。这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]上没有任何值得一提的智慧生物，所以这一定是座被遗弃的哨站。它的年代不算久远，但却无法使用了。

我们需要修理并研究它才能让它恢复运作，不过要是拆毁它也许能够让我们学习到新的技术。
descriptions.en:
We have found a sensor array, solemnly standing watch on [From.GetName]. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has no sapient life to speak of, so it must be an abandoned outpost. It was built recently, but is not functioning.

It would require both repairs and research to bring it back into working condition, while breaking it apart could allow us to learn something new from it.

label.zh: 不管它，也许它的主人会归来。
label.en: Leave it alone in case the owner returns.

descriptions.zh: 数个月的工作终于开花结果了！[From.From.From.GetName]的传感阵列再一次恢复了运作，现在我们在附近一带的扫描范围更大了。不过传感阵列需要更多的能量和人力才能正常运行，所以我们需要建立一个殖民地来维持它。
descriptions.en: Months of work have finally paid off! The sensor array on [From.From.From.GetName] is once again functioning and it appears to be able to give us a vastly improved sensor range of the nearby area. However, the array needs more energy and personnel to work, so a colony is needed in order to supply it with energy.

descriptions.zh:
我们在围绕着[From.GetName]的小行星中发现了一艘外星飞船在那里漂泊。它对我们的联络新号毫无反应。它到底是无法解析我们的信号，还是可能因为其他原因无视我们，我们无从得知。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议我们派遣一艘工程船来，将其拖出碎片区。要是不管它的话，这艘外星飞船很可能会被小行星撞碎。

已发布一项§S特殊项目§!去拯救飞船并调查它。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered an alien ship adrift among the asteroids surrounding [From.GetName]. It is not responding to our hailing signals. Whether this is due to it being unable to interpret our signal, or perhaps some other reason, we do not know.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends that a construction ship be dispatched to tow this stricken vessel out of the debris field. If left untouched, there is a risk the alien ship may be crushed by the asteroids.

A §SSpecial Project§! has been issued to rescue and investigate the ship.

descriptions.zh:
漂泊在[From.From.From.GetName]的飞船被拖拉出来，我们得以派遣特遣队去调查它。里面发生过一场谋杀。只找到了一位船员的尸体——那是一个长耳朵的两栖双腿生物，他身上有多处刺伤。该舰船因为没有了主人，已归我们所有。

该舰船拥有非常高效的推进器，它的架构和设计都高于我们当前的水准。飞船没有装备武器，看来是一艘运送重要人员的运输船。

把它改造成勘探船无需花费多大功夫。不过，如果我们拆毁它并仔细研究它的引擎，也许就能够对我们的舰队水平有实际提升。
descriptions.en:
Once the ship drifting by [From.From.From.GetName] was towed out of the debris, we were able to send in an away team to investigate. They uncovered a murder scene. Only one crew member has been found - a long-eared, amphibian biped who appears to have been stabbed repeatedly.

With its crew evidently dead, the ship is now up for grabs. It is fitted with very efficient thrusters, the structure and design of which are beyond us at present. The vessel is not armed, seemingly having been used as a transport for important personnel.

Repurposing it into an exploration vessel would be a minor undertaking. However, if we deconstruct it and study the engines in greater detail, we may instead be able to apply its ingenious design to our own fleets.

label.en: Repurpose it into a science vessel.

tooltips.zh: 获得一艘§Y通讯船§!。
tooltips.en: Gain a §YCourier§!-class ship.

label.en: Tear it down and study the engines.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的森林让船员们大吃一惊。这不仅仅是一个充斥着各种有机生物的高度发展的世界，而且大部分植物的根茎都能吃。或许不算美味，但这代表我们可以轻易地在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的肥沃土壤上耕种。
descriptions.en: The forests of [From.GetName] have blown the crew's expectations away. It is not only a highly developed world rich in organic life, but most plant roots are even edible. This might not sound appetizing, but it indicates that we could easily grow food on this [From.GetPlanetMoon], due to the rich soil.

tooltips.zh: 添加§G青葱行星§!修正到[From.GetName]。
tooltips.en: Adds the §GLush Planet§! modifier to [From.GetName].

titles.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]上，科学官[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了一种身体健壮、适应力极强的四足哺乳生物。他们可以徒步涉水，即使是高大的植物也仅仅达到它们的腿部。 这些生物的暗色鳞片非常坚硬，而且在陌生人靠近时极易受惊。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。
descriptions.en:
On [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered a race of quadruped mammalians who appear very strong and physically resilient. They run across shallow plains of water, with lush plants reaching for their legs. The dark scales of the creatures are rock hard, and they are very skittish when approached.

It might be possible to domesticate the beasts and have them assist in potential future colonization of the planet. However, we might however happen across some interesting revelations by studying them first.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]上，科学官[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了一种身体健壮、适应力极强的四足哺乳生物。他们可以徒步涉水，即使是高大的植物也仅仅达到它们的腿部。

[Root.GetLeaderName]发现这种动物有某种灵能能力，从它们的行为变化上看，它们可以感应到我们的意图。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。

[Root.GetLeaderName]说这些当地生物会“对不怀好意的人反馈负面回应”。
descriptions.en:
On [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered a race of quadruped mammalians who appear very strong and physically resilient. They run across shallow plains of water, with lush plants reaching for their legs.

[Root.GetLeaderName] have been able to deduce that the animals have some sort of psionic ability, as changes in their demeanor indicates that they are able to intuitively sense our intentions.

It might be possible to domesticate the beasts and have them assist in potential future colonization of the planet. However, we might however happen across some interesting revelations by studying them first.

[Root.GetLeaderName] claims that the indigenous creatures seem to "respond negatively to thoughts that indicate any sort of threat."

label.zh: 研究它们，找出更多信息。
label.en: Study them to find out more.
Try to domesticate them right away.

label.zh: 让它们自由自在地生活。

titles.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

descriptions.zh:
我们试图靠近它们做研究，但进展并不顺利。它们一发现我们靠近，就要么逃走要么战斗，它们好像从大老远就能发现我们。

这些动物明显清楚我们的意图，所以尽量避免跟我们接触。

至少我们可以从远距离研究它们，也许会有所发现。
descriptions.en:
Our attempts to study the animals up close has yielded few results. They run away or fight back as soon as we approach, as if they knew we are coming way before we have even sighted their herds.

The beasts clearly understand what we are trying to do, somehow, and avoid being in close proximity to us.

At least we can keep studying them from afar and maybe learn something interesting.

label.zh: 这最起码是一种意志坚定的动物。
label.en: A strong-willed animal to say the least.

titles.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

descriptions.zh:
接触这些动物的进展相当顺利！它们似乎拥有一种灵能感应，可以通过精神彼此沟通以及跟我们沟通。

它们想要自由自在地生活在大地上，尽情享受那里的水果。如果我们不打扰它们的生存空间和食物，它们愿意在必要时帮助我们。

这段佳话应当被广泛传播到人们的耳中。
descriptions.en:
Approaching the animals have yielded results! They appear to have psionic capabilities, able to communicate with each other, and us, via telepathy.

They wish to be free, roam the land and eat of its fruits. We would have their support, as fellow creatures of the cosmos, if we simply allow them their space and leave their food sources untouched.

Positive stories of how this situation was resolved is bound to spread to the general populace.

label.en: We need the food for ourselves.

titles.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

descriptions.zh: 这些动物非常难以驯服。为了靠近它们，我们被迫使用了暴力和麻醉剂。我们要驱使它们的时候，它们总是反抗。我们必须强迫它们完成工作，但效果不太好。
descriptions.en: The animals are proving difficult to tame. In order to get even close to them we have to use some force and eventually sedate them. They consistently fight back when we try to put them to work. We will have to force them to perform their tasks, which hasn't turned out to be very efficient.

titles.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

descriptions.zh:
这些动物非常难以相处。虽然我们已经尽可能地温柔了，但其中一部分还是逃走和反抗。我们聚集了比较温驯的一批，训练它们工作。但其中一部分还是抗拒了。我们现在有一小群个体愿意帮忙我们，但这相比整支族群明显低效了很多。

我们驯服这些动物的消息一旦传入大众耳中，可能会对我们的声誉造成负面影响。
descriptions.en:
The animals have been difficult to work with. While we have been as gentle as possible in our advance, some of them still flee and resist. We have gathered the calmer specimens and made them work the earth for tests. Some rejected that too. We now have a small selection of individuals that are willing to help us, but they will not be as effective as the entire herd.

The way we enslaved these animals may paint us in a bad light, once word spreads to the general populace.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]行星是一片有毒废土，但是我们的扫描发现这里曾经不是现在这样的。一个如今已毁灭的文明因为过度依赖改变气候的燃料和毒素而彻底毁了自己的这个母星。

在一个大城市附近的一处偏僻山丘上，我们发现了一座还能运行的设施。这是一个组装机器人的工厂，周围泊满了军用车辆。但这些车辆稍稍一碰就化成了尘埃。

这座设施非常神秘奇特，但也许能够提供不少研究材料。
descriptions.en:
The planet [From.GetName] is a toxic wasteland, but our scans unveil that it has not always been so. A now extinct civilization seems to have destroyed its home planet, via a heavy reliance on climate altering fuels and toxins.

On a remote hill, close to a major city, we have found a lone active facility. A robot assembly plant, desolated and surrounded by military vehicles, so deteriorated they break upon touch.

The facility is alien and mysterious, but could provide us with ample study material.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = no } }

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]星球是一片剧毒而有腐蚀性的废土，但我们的扫描发现它并非一直如此。一个现已灭绝的有机体文明似乎因重度依赖改变气候的燃料与毒素，而摧毁了自己的母星。

在靠近一座大型城市的偏远的山丘上，我们发现了一个尚在运行的设施。这是一个荒弃的机器人组装工厂，周围泊满了严重腐朽的军用车辆，稍稍一碰就化成了尘埃。

这座设施非常神秘奇特，但也许能够提供不少研究材料。
descriptions.en:
The planet [From.GetName] is a toxic, corrosive wasteland, but our scans unveil that it has not always been so. A now extinct organic civilization seems to have destroyed its home planet, via a heavy reliance on climate altering fuels and toxins.

On a remote hill, close to a major city, we have found a lone active facility. A robot assembly plant, desolated and surrounded by military vehicles, so deteriorated they break upon touch.

The facility is alien and mysterious, but could provide us with ample study material.

[From.From.From.GetName]上的那座设施因为科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的努力而恢复运作了。

机器人们启动后马上各就各位工作。[From.GetName]的船员们目瞪口呆，看着机器人们向四面八方移动，开始清除整颗星球上的毒素。

这不禁让人猜测之前的居住者是因为过度关注于自相残杀而忽略了自救。
descriptions.en:
The facility on [From.From.From.GetName] lights up as Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s plan finally comes to fruition.

The robots activate and immediately move with purpose. The crew of the [From.GetName] stare in shock, but warrantedly so, as the machines move out across the world, starting to cleanse the toxicity from it.

One could assume that the previous inhabitants were too wrapped up in conflict to save themselves.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的沙丘危险重重。那些光滑细腻的细沙就像液体般，对着陆造成了不可估量的困难。

不过，我们机智的科学团队想到了一个创新的方法。由科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]配制的一种化学溶剂可以凝固关键地点的沙堆，让我们更容易地穿越[From.GetPlanetMoon]表面。
descriptions.en:
The sand dunes of [From.GetName] are treacherous indeed. The fine grained sand runs almost like a liquid, making most landings an ordeal beyond measure.

However, our brilliant science team has found a solution thanks to some innovative thinking. A chemical solution, fabricated by Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], can be used to bind the sand in key locations, making the [From.GetPlanetMoon] easier to traverse.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的沙丘危险重重。这些沙粒如此的细小，我们几乎可以将其完全看作液体，它会吞没一切踏足其上者。在这里殖民只会徒然地损失人力和设备。

也许随着时间推移，我们会学会如何适应这样的环境。有句老话说得好：“站在前人的地基上。”
descriptions.en:
The sand dunes of [From.GetName] are treachearous indeed. The sand is so finely grained that it almost could be called a liquid, and it swallows anything that sets down upon it. Settling here would take a heavy toll on personnel as well as structures.

With time we could probably learn how to work around these conditions. As the saying went: "Eventually our castle would stand upon the old one."

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]出大事了！研究结束后并无重大发现，船员便返回到船上，却发现[From.GetPlanetMoon]的某只猛兽竟然跑上了船！

该生物已经杀害了一位船员，并正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的船员们。他们撑不了多久！已经发布一个§S特殊项目§!去救人了。
descriptions.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying a beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already killed a crew member and is trying to claw itself through the walls to get to the others. They won't last long at this rate! A §SSpecial Project§! has been issued to save the ship.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = no } }

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]发生了大灾难！在进行研究而一无所获之后，船员们返回飞船时却发现上面有一只来自[From.GetPlanetMoon]的有机体猛兽！

这只猛兽已经瘫痪了一个船员单位，且正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的单位。这样下去他们活不长了！拯救舰船的§S特殊项目§!已经发布。
descriptions.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying an organic beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already rendered one crew member unit inoperable, and is trying to claw itself through the walls to get to the others. They won't last long at this rate! A §SSpecial Project§! has been issued to save the ship.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = yes } }

tooltips.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!被摧毁了。
tooltips.en: The §Y[Root.GetName]§! is destroyed.

descriptions.zh: 我们的救援队成功击毙了[From.From.GetName]上的那只猛兽。科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]和船员们都受到了惊吓，但依然能够胜任各自的职务。他们非常感激士兵们的援救，这件事激发了人们参军的热情。
descriptions.en: Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the team are rather traumatized, but assure that they are still fit for duty. Their appreciation of the soldiers saving them goes viral and we can already see a boost in new enlistees.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = no } }

descriptions.zh:
我们的救援队成功地消灭了[From.From.GetName]上的猛兽。科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]及其团队只受到了轻微的损伤，并仍可执行任务。武装单元成功排除有机威胁的行动引起了机械合成工厂对于机械安全的广泛重视。

因此，我们的作战单元的建造速度以及动机软件的有效性已有所提高。
descriptions.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the team have sustained negligible damage, and are still fit for duty. The success of our armed units in dispatching the organic menace has roused renewed focus among the assembly yards responsible for their construction.

As a result, we are noting an increase in combat unit build-speed and motivation software effectuality.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = yes } }

我们的救援队成功击毙了[From.From.GetName]上的那只猛兽。可惜他们没能及时拯救科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]，后者为了保护船员们而阵亡了。

至少飞船无损，船员们很快就可以恢复工作。我们的母星沸腾了，都为我们的士兵们的英勇行为点赞。
descriptions.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Sadly they didn't make it in time to save Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] who died while trying to protect the crew.

At least the ship is intact and the crew says they can go back to work soon. Our homeworld becomes abuzz about our military's bravery in handling the situation.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = no } }

descriptions.zh:
我们的救援队成功地消灭了[From.From.GetName]上的猛兽。不幸的是，他们未能及时拯救试图保护船员而受到了致命损伤的科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]。

至少舰船依旧完好无损，而船上其它单位表示他们很快就能恢复正常机能。我们母星主控电路正忙于升级军事相关算法以更好的应对未来可能发生的类似事件。
descriptions.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, they didn't make it in time to save Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName], who took terminal damage while trying to protect the crew units.

At least the ship is intact and the crew informs us they can resume normal functions soon. Our homeworld's circuits are abuzz with updates on our military's efficacy in handling the situation.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_machine_empire = yes } }

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]盛产大自然的奇迹。巨大的七彩爆炸出现在空中，这是因为大气层中的化学成分跟恒星的伽马射线产生了反应。

学生们和高级科学家们都在传播着这个消息，消息如野火般扩散开来。科学领域中的相关人员都对此产生了兴趣。
descriptions.en:
The [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] is the home of a marvel of nature. Giant colorful explosions appear in the sky, a result of the chemical composition of the atmosphere reacting to the sun's gamma rays.

Students and senior scientists alike are spreading this find like a wildfire. It has generated quite the spark of interest for the scientific field amongst our people.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的小行星带，一棵大树在空旷的太空中漂浮着。这样空前未有的事情真是说出来谁都不敢信！大树被一个保护层般的泡泡包围着，看上去像个能源护盾。

我们突然检测到敌对的太空种群正在接近！这恰巧发生在我们采集样本并有树液从护盾中流出来的时候，难道它们是被这东西吸引过来的？
descriptions.en:
Among the asteroids around [From.GetName] a tree is drifting through the emptiness of space. An unprecedented and highly unlikely event! The tree is surrounded in a protective bubble, reminiscent of an energy shield.

Suddenly we detect some hostile space dwellers on approach! This coincided with some sap leaking through the trees shield while we collected samples. Could it have agitated the creatures?

label.zh: 我们得查出到底发生什么事了！
label.en: We need to figure out what is going on!

descriptions.zh:
经过仔细的研究我们终于明白为什么树液会把那些生物吸引过来了。这棵树会生产一种非常高营养价值的液体，可以修复细胞组织。这简直是生命之树啊！

如果我们可以采集这东西，我们就能够延长人们的寿命。但问题是：大树就一棵而已，我们要么大幅提升一小群人的寿命，要么小幅提升所有人的寿命。
descriptions.en:
After rigorous research we now understand why the tree's sap summoned those creatures. The tree is able to produce a highly nutritious substance, which has machine-like abilities to repair organic tissue. The tree is a tree of life!

If we harvested it we could use it to expand the lifespan of our people. But there is one problem: the tree's healing power is limited in amount. We could only use it to improve a small group of peoples' life substantially, or increase everyone's situation by a small amount.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[From.GetName]上有重大发现。该行星上的沙丘隐藏着一些废墟，是属于一个星际种群的。这类殖民地大都敌不过时间的洗礼。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快发现了一个藏有珍贵物品和文件的储物箱。既然这些文件是跟珍贵物品保存在一起，那一定相当重要。
descriptions.en:
On [From.GetName] the crew of the [Root.GetName] have found something extraordinary. The planet's dunes have hid several ruins, belonging to an interstellar civilization of settlers. The settlements have long been destroyed by the ravages of time.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is quick to discover a stored cache of valuables and documents. The collection of texts must have been most revered by the settlers, as they were stored amongst other valuables.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

descriptions.zh: [From.From.From.GetName]上发现的文件似乎也是说书人特丽莎的著作。这些文件详细地解释如何重整基础设施和塑造社会。她的意思是所有人都牺牲自己的一部分幸福，为帝国共创美好的未来。
descriptions.en: It seems that the text we found on [From.From.From.GetName] is another piece created by "Telisa the Teller of Tales."The documents explicitly details how you can refocus infrastructure and shape society. She meant that by having everyone sacrifice some of their comfort for the greater good the nation will flourish.

descriptions.zh:
我们的语言专家废寝忘食数个月，终于成功翻译了[From.From.From.GetName]上找到的文献。这些文件是一位被称为说书人特丽莎的著作。她似乎是位非常有名的哲学家、社会学家、关系学家。

这些文件详细地解释如何重整基础设施和塑造社会。她的意思是所有人都牺牲自己的一部分幸福，为帝国共创美好的未来。
descriptions.en:
Having had our linguistics experts hard at work for months, we've finally succeeded in translating the works found on [From.From.From.GetName].The papers are the teachings of an alien scholar only referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales." All mentions of her points to her being a famous philosopher and overall expert on society and relations.

The documents explicitly details how you can refocus infrastructure and shape society. She meant that by having everyone sacrifice some of their comfort for the greater good the nation will flourish.

tooltips.zh: 可以使用§Y大师的教诲：上上善道§!的帝国法令。
tooltips.en: Gives access to the §YMaster's Teachings: The Greater Good§! Empire Edict.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员发来报告称，他们在[From.GetName]上找到了惊人的发现。其他文明的探索队在其表面留下了痕迹，并遗留了一些保存完好的档案及文物。

首席科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议将文献送回母星破译。但也可以将其卖给私人投资者。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName]'s crew is reporting that they've found something spectacular on [From.GetName]. On the surface lies traces of an explorative expedition of another civilization. Left behind are some well-preserved documents and artifacts.

The proposed action by chief Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is to send the text findings to our homeworld for translation. There is also the possibility to sell them off to a private investor.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

descriptions.zh:
谁能想到呢？我们发现的文献记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。这次，是一些对更宏观问题的哲思与分析。

她的教诲让我们对治理帝国有了更加深刻的理解，通过应用不同的看法，并在革命时关注宏观问题，可以获得更好的治理成果。
descriptions.en:
Who would've thought? The texts we found were more teachings from "Telisa the Teller of Tales." This time it's a collection of philosophical ponderings and analysis on larger questions.

Her teachings have provided us with much insight into how to better gain political results via applying different states of mind and use larger scale questions as a focus for reform.

descriptions.zh:
通过数周的研究，我们的语言学专家破解了[From.From.From.GetName]的文档中包含的内容。该文档记录了一位知名学者的哲学思辨，她被称为“说书人特丽莎”。

她的教诲让我们对治理帝国有了更加深刻的理解，通过应用不同的看法，并在革命时关注宏观问题，可以获得更好的治理成果。
descriptions.en:
After many weeks of study, our expert linguists have unearthed the meaning behind the documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The documents were philosophical ponderings by a famous scholar, only referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

Her teachings have provided us with much insight into how to better gain political results via applying different states of mind and use larger scale questions as a focus for reform.

tooltips.zh: 可以使用§Y大师的教诲：哲学思辨§!的帝国法令。
tooltips.en: Gives access to the §YMaster's Teachings: Philosophical Mindset§! Empire Edict.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的表面屹立着值得注意的建筑群。这些遗迹拥有不同的建筑风格，但都建于同一时代。[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾经可能是一个交易中心。

某些遗迹中存有文档和财物。我们可以通过研究文本来尝试翻译，以便了解曾定居在这里的生物。我们也可以将其卖给古董收藏家。
descriptions.en:
The surface of [From.GetName] holds something remarkable. Multiple ruins can be found, built using different architectures, yet from the same point in history. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] might have been a trading hub!

Some ruins held stored documents and valuables. If we studied the texts we might be able to translate them and learn more about the people who settled here. Or we could sell them to someone who values old heirlooms.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

descriptions.zh:
谁能想到呢？我们发现的文献记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。

这份文档记录了一些奇闻趣事、如何从星际外交中获取最大利益的建议和技巧。她相信，公平贸易和互相尊重的沟通可以为各界带来巨大的社会进步。
descriptions.en:
Who would've thought? The texts we found were more teachings from "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

The documents we found were a collection of anecdotes, suggestions and techniques for how to optimally partake in interstellar diplomacy. She seemed to have believed that good trade and respectful communication would achieve great social advancements for all parties.

descriptions.zh:
我们天才的语言学专家正在努力翻译[From.From.From.GetName]上发现的文献。文献的作者被称作“说书人特丽莎”，似乎是当时的德高望重之人。

这份文档记录了一些奇闻趣事、如何从星际外交中获取最大利益的建议和技巧。她相信，公平贸易和互相尊重的沟通可以为各界带来巨大的社会进步。
descriptions.en:
Our most talented linguists have been hard at work in translating the documents we found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The scribe behind these works is referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales," and it seems she was highly revered during her time.

The documents we found were a collection of anecdotes, suggestions and techniques for how to optimally partake in interstellar diplomacy. She seemed to have believed that good trade and respectful communication would achieve great social advancements for all parties.

tooltips.zh: 可以使用§Y大师的教诲：外交信任§!的帝国法令。
tooltips.en: Gives access to the §YMaster's Teachings: Diplomatic Trust§! Empire Edict.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]曾经拥有一个高等文明。但他们早已成为历史尘埃。异形猛兽在星球表面的远古战场上肆虐横行。

在石山地区的山脉底部藏有一个避难所。如果我们能先处理掉地表的猛兽，我们就可以继续调查。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName] used to hold an advanced civilization. It is now dead silent. Alien beasts roam old battlefields that stretch across the surface.

In a rocky region there seems to lie a hidden vault beneath the mountains. If we could get rid of the beasts roaming the landscape we could investigate it.

label.en: Let's try and get to it!

label.zh: 远离避难所和在那里游荡的灵魂。
label.en: Leave the vault, and its wandering spirits be.

descriptions.zh:
清除猛兽后，我们进入了避难所。内部似乎是一间指挥室，为这个死亡文明的领袖们提供最后的庇护。

避难所内全是破损的设备和腐烂的尸体。唯一值得调查的是一个容器，可能装有十分重要的东西。
descriptions.en:
With the beasts removed, we could access the vault. Inside it lay a headquarter of sorts, a last refuge for a dying world's leaders.

The vault is filled with destroyed equipment and decomposed corpses. The only thing of interest being a container, which potentially holds something of importance.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.

label.zh: 以防万一，只研究避难所。
label.en: Only study the vault to avoid risks.

descriptions.zh:
在[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]上发现的容器原来是一个冷藏装置！封存的外星人已经苏醒。她用心灵感应说道：

“为什么叫醒我？我们一族的战争结束了吗？”
descriptions.en:
The container found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] turned out to be a cryogenic device! The preserved alien within has awoken. She speaks using telepathic concepts:

"Why have you brought me back, captor? Is the war of my people over?"

label.zh: 你目前在[HomePlanet.GetName]上。这里很安全。
label.en: You are on [HomePlanet.GetName]. You are safe here.

label.zh: 你的家乡被战争毁灭了，只有你幸存。
label.en: Your home planet was ruined by the war, only you remain.

label.zh: 我们尽力从你们被毁的家园抢救物资。
label.en: We salvaged what we could of your ruined homeworld.

descriptions.zh: “我就怕这种事发生。希望我的知识和我们种群的悲剧能带给别人教诲。”
descriptions.en: "I feared that this would happen. I only hope that my knowledge, and our failure as a species, can teach others."

label.zh: 在战时被冷冻，你一定是个重要人物？
label.en: To be frozen in war you must be of high value?

label.zh: 你是出于什么神圣的任务而被冷藏的吗？
label.en: Were you preserved for a divine mission?

label.zh: 离开吧。你的命运由你自己掌控。
label.en: Leave. Your fate is your own.
You are of no use to us. Leave!

descriptions.zh: “是这样吗……我就怕醒来时会得到这个消息。说实话，我更怕永远醒不过来。你们一族想从我这里获得什么？”
descriptions.en: "So that's why... I feared that I would wake up to these news. To be honest I feared I would never wake at all. What does your kind want of me?"

label.en: To be frozen in war you must be of high value?

label.zh: 你是出于什么神圣的任务而被冷藏的吗？
label.en: Were you preserved for a divine mission?

label.zh: 离开吧。你的命运由你自己掌控。
label.en: Leave. Your fate is your own.
You are of no use to us. Leave!

descriptions.zh: “你的话语和你的文明向我证明了一切，捕获者。我会加入你，希望你能吸取我们种群的教训。”
descriptions.en: "Your words, and your civilization speaks to me, captor. I will join you, in hopes that you will learn from my people's mistakes.

descriptions.zh: 你的话语，还有这个房间的氛围，都证明了我们的观点不合。所以我不会加入你。我会回到[WarriorHomePlanet.GetName]，穷尽一生讲述它的故事。
descriptions.en: The way you speak. The way this room speaks for you. It tells me that our views do not align, captor. So no, I will not join you. I will return to [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName], and tell its stories for as long as I remain."

options.script: name = anomaly.4161.a

descriptions.zh:
“宁死不屈！”

玛居拉愤怒地冲出房间。外面的人群正准备进行阻拦，她就抓住了一名研究员作为人质。在逃离过程中，人质不幸牺牲而玛居拉也被警卫击毙。
descriptions.en:
"I would rather die!"

Majula runs out of the room, enraged. As a crowd had gathered outside to take part in the proceedings she grabs a researcher to use as leverage. In the escape, the researcher dies before Majula is gunned down by security.

options.script: name = CURSES

descriptions.zh: “再见了，捕获者。试着吸取我们物种的教训，千万不要在我们下一次相遇时，你也成了你们物种的最后一人。”
descriptions.en: "Farewell, captor. Try and learn from what happened to my people, lest we meet again and you too have ended up to be the last of your kind."

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]的荒野上，发现了战斗过的痕迹。在毫无生机的地表下，[Root.GetName]的研究员发现了骸骨和金属碎片，最令人吃惊的是一个装着文档的容器。

如果我们将文档送回母星破译，我们有机会了解这场战争和参与战争的种群。但也可以直接将其卖给古董商。
descriptions.en:
Across the barren fields of [From.GetName] there are indications of old battles being fought. Beneath the lifeless ground our researchers on the [Root.GetName] have found bones, metallic shards and, most surprisingly, a container filled with documents.

If we send the documents to our homeworld for translation we could potentially learn more about this war and who fought in it. It would also be possible to simply sell them off as antiques.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

descriptions.zh:
我们从战场上挖掘到的文献上记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。

这个文档对各种战术、战略进行了解析，最关键的是，其中包含星际战争的后勤学。特丽莎本人强烈反对战争，但她认为这种知识在未来时代仍然十分重要。“为了创建更美好的世界，即便是最和平的种群，也会有被逼迫到死角的时候。”
descriptions.en:
It appears that the texts we found buried in the battlefield were more teachings written by "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

The documents are breakdowns of tactics, strategy and, most importantly, logistics in interstellar warfare. Being a strong spokesperson against war, Telisa still found this to be essential knowledge for steering into the future. "Even the most peaceful of people might be forced into a corner in their work for a better world."

descriptions.zh:
几周来，我们的语言学专家一直在破译远古战场留下的文档。今天研究有了一些进展。我们得知，倒下的勇士遵循的教义来自于一个叫“说书人特丽莎”的哲学家。

这个文档对各种战术、战略进行了解析，最关键的是，其中包含星际战争的后勤学。特丽莎本人强烈反对战争，但她认为这种知识在未来时代仍然十分重要。“为了创建更美好的世界，即便是最和平的种群，也会有被逼迫到死角的时候。”
descriptions.en:
Our language experts have been at it for weeks to try and translate the documents we found in the old battlefield. Today we finally have some results. We now know that the fallen warriors all followed the teachings of a philosopher called "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

The documents are breakdowns of tactics, strategy and, most importantly, logistics in interstellar warfare. Being a strong spokesperson against war, Telisa still found this to be essential knowledge for steering into the future. "Even the most peaceful of people might be forced into a corner in their work for a better world."

tooltips.en: Gives access to the §YMaster's Teachings: Warring States§! Empire Edict.

label.zh: 看来智者也会选择战争。
label.en: Even the wise can go to war it seems.

tooltips.en: Gives access to the §YMaster's Teachings: Warring States§! Empire Edict.

descriptions.zh:
扫描结果显示，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表下拥有高浓度的天然气。这种丰厚的资源非常高效节能，可以大大增加地表设施的能源产出。

它带来的好处远比对环境造成的破坏要大。
descriptions.en:
Scans of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] has unveiled dense deposits of natural gases underneath the surface. The rich resource is extremely energy efficient and would greatly increase the energy output of our surface production.

The potential gain this would serve to us because heavily outweighs any damage that could be caused to the environment.

descriptions.zh:
扫描结果显示，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表下拥有高浓度的天然气。这种丰厚的资源非常高效节能，可以大大增加地表设施的能源产出。

然而，这些资源将会很快耗尽，因为储量稀少、体积较小。
descriptions.en:
Scans of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] has unveiled dense deposits of natural gases underneath the surface. The rich resource is extremely energy efficient and would greatly increase the energy output of our surface production.

However, using these resources would deplete them rather quickly, as the deposits are rare and small in size.

descriptions.zh: 富含能源的气体已经耗尽。这个殖民地已失去额外的资源输出，大大增加了我们对新矿藏的需求。
descriptions.en: The energy rich gas found on one of our colonies has now depleted. The extra resource output has been lost, greatly increasing our need for new deposits to replace it.

descriptions.zh: 我们占据的殖民地曾拥有丰富的地下气体资源。但现在已经耗尽，工厂的能源输出降低。
descriptions.en: The colony we took over used to hold rich resources of gas underneath the surface. Now they've depleted, reducing the energy output of our industries.
